initial_prompt:

At top-right exact Latin wordmark "Urdu Ai", bold Montserrat SemiBold equivalent; "Urdu" white and "Ai" gold #FFBE0B; lowercase i. No additional text, fake UI, random logos, watermark, malformed hands, purple-wave default, gaming aesthetic, or crypto aesthetic. Overall credible refined newspaper science cover, strongly composed as a landscape 1200×630 image.
